name: create-ots-instance-with-vpc
description: Create OTS instance with tables and attach to VPC
usecase: This example demonstrates how to create an OTS instance with multiple tables and attach it to a VPC. It creates new VPC/VSwitch resources.

inputs.name: instance_name
inputs.description: The name of the OTS instance to create

inputs.name: table_schemas
inputs.description: Map of table names to their primary key definitions

inputs.name: attach_vpc
inputs.description: Whether to attach a VPC to the OTS instance
